title: White House EOP navigation page is not an exhaustive component roster
summary: The EOP landing page links six entities, while the White House executive-branch description also identifies immediate presidential staff and entities such as USTR; the six-link page should not be treated as a statutory organogram.

evidence.observation: The EOP landing page presents six linked entities.
The broader executive-branch page describes the EOP as immediate staff plus additional entities, including USTR.

provenance.method: free-range five-role primary-source review and bounded graph synthesis

data.claim: The White House EOP landing page is a public navigation surface, not an exhaustive legal roster of all Executive Office components.

linked_entities: Office of Science and Technology Policy
Office of the National Cyber Director
Office of National Drug Control Policy
object.counterexample: The broader White House executive-branch page also describes immediate presidential staff and entities such as the Office of the United States Trade Representative.
object.boundary: Website navigation count is not a statutory component count.

data.adjudication: Use statutes, appropriations materials, organizational records, and office pages for exhaustive enumeration.
